task_plan_contracts_note: Each task may declare plan_contracts as a list of entries {id, statement, source, lands_in?, proof?}: statement is ONE checkable claim, source names the plan file and section, lands_in the repo-relative file the claim lands in, and proof the id of the required test that fails while the claim is unmet (decision 0082). The recorder requires non-empty strings, proof to name one of the task's required_tests, and contract ids unique across the whole decomposition.
